items.title_cn: 中国DeepSeek引发AI股全面抛售，市场遭遇重挫
items.title_en: Stocks Sink in Broad AI Rout Sparked by China's DeepSeek
items.summary_cn: 中国AI公司DeepSeek的突破性进展引发全球AI相关股票广泛抛售，市场担忧其低成本模型可能颠覆现有竞争格局。投资者重新评估AI领域估值，英伟达等龙头股领跌。这一事件凸显地缘政治与技术创新对资本市场的双重冲击，值得关注AI产业链的深层变革与风险重定价。
items.summary_en: Breakthroughs from Chinese AI company DeepSeek triggered a broad sell-off in global AI-related stocks, with markets worried that its low-cost models could disrupt the existing competitive landscape. Investors are reassessing valuations in the AI sector, with leaders like Nvidia taking the hardest hit. The event highlights the dual impact of geopolitics and technological innovation on capital markets, warranting attention to deeper shifts and risk repricing across the AI supply chain.

items.title_cn: Comex黄金与白银期货收低
items.title_en: Comex Gold, Silver Settle Lower
items.summary_cn: Comex黄金和白银期货周五收低，受美元走强及美联储加息预期升温打压。金价跌破关键支撑位，白银跌幅更大，因工业需求前景蒙阴。市场关注下周通胀数据及美联储官员讲话，以寻找政策路径线索。此次下跌反映投资者对紧缩周期延长的担忧，贵金属短期承压，但避险需求仍提供底部支撑。值得关注的是，若通胀数据超预期，可能加剧波动。
items.summary_en: Comex gold and silver futures settled lower on Friday, pressured by a stronger dollar and rising expectations of Federal Reserve rate hikes. Gold broke below a key support level, while silver fell more sharply amid a dimmer industrial demand outlook. Markets await next week's inflation data and Fed speeches for clues on the policy path. The decline reflects investor concerns over an extended tightening cycle, keeping precious metals under short-term pressure, though safe-haven demand still provides a floor. Notably, an upside inflation surprise could amplify volatility.

items.title_cn: DeepSeek撼动不了美国AI巨头
items.title_en: DeepSeek Won't Sink U.S. AI Titans
items.summary_cn: 本文深入分析DeepSeek的崛起是否真的会威胁美国AI巨头的地位。文章指出，尽管DeepSeek以低成本高性能引发市场震动，但其技术路径、生态壁垒与商业模式的局限性决定了它难以撼动美国头部AI企业的根基。对于关注AI竞争格局与投资趋势的读者，本文提供了冷静而独到的视角，值得一读。
items.summary_en: This article examines whether DeepSeek's rise truly threatens U.S. AI giants. It argues that despite DeepSeek's market disruption with low-cost, high-performance models, its technical approach, ecosystem barriers, and business model limitations mean it cannot shake the foundations of leading American AI companies. For readers tracking AI competition and investment trends, this piece offers a calm and insightful perspective worth reading.

items.title_cn: 金融服务综述：市场观察
items.title_en: Financial Services Roundup: Market Talk
items.summary_cn: 该内容为金融服务领域的市场动态汇总，涵盖行业最新交易、机构观点与市场趋势。对于关注金融板块的投资者而言，此类综述能快速捕捉市场情绪与关键信息，帮助判断短期波动背后的逻辑，值得一看。
items.summary_en: This content provides a roundup of market developments in the financial services sector, covering the latest deals, institutional views, and market trends. For investors focused on financials, such a digest offers a quick grasp of market sentiment and key information, helping to interpret the logic behind short-term moves and making it worth a look.

items.title_cn: 美哥关税争端推动阿拉比卡咖啡价格创历史新高
items.title_en: Arabica Coffee Prices Hit Record on U.S., Colombia Tariff Spat
items.summary_cn: 美国与哥伦比亚之间的关税争端升级，直接冲击全球咖啡供应链，阿拉比卡咖啡期货价格飙升至历史最高点。这一事件凸显了地缘政治与贸易政策对大宗商品市场的即时影响力，值得投资者关注：关税摩擦不仅推高咖啡消费成本，还可能重塑全球咖啡贸易格局，并加剧食品通胀压力。
items.summary_en: Escalating tariff disputes between the U.S. and Colombia have directly disrupted the global coffee supply chain, driving Arabica coffee futures to an all-time high. This event highlights the immediate impact of geopolitical and trade policies on commodity markets and is worth watching: tariff frictions not only raise consumer costs for coffee but may also reshape global coffee trade flows and intensify food inflation pressures.

items.title_cn: DeepSeek消息提振避险需求，瑞郎与日元走强
items.title_en: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
items.summary_cn: DeepSeek相关消息引发市场避险情绪升温，瑞士法郎与日元作为传统避险货币应声上涨。这一动态值得关注，因为它反映出市场对科技领域不确定性的敏感反应，以及避险资金流向的快速切换。投资者需留意，若DeepSeek事件持续发酵，可能进一步影响全球外汇市场格局与风险偏好。
items.summary_en: News related to DeepSeek has boosted safe-haven demand, driving the Swiss franc and Japanese yen higher. This development is noteworthy as it reflects market sensitivity to uncertainties in the tech sector and the rapid shift in safe-haven capital flows. Investors should watch for potential further impacts on global forex markets and risk appetite if the DeepSeek situation continues to evolve.

items.title_cn: 天气预测变化致天然气价格下跌
items.title_en: Natural Gas Falls on Shifting Weather Forecasts
items.summary_cn: 近期天然气价格因天气预测的调整而出现下跌。天气预报的变化直接影响市场对取暖和发电需求的预期，进而引发价格波动。本文分析了天气因素如何主导短期天然气走势，并探讨了库存水平与供需基本面的相互作用。对于关注能源市场的投资者而言，理解天气预测与价格之间的敏感关系，有助于把握交易节奏和风险管理。值得一看的是，文章还提到了未来几周天气模式可能带来的进一步波动风险。
items.summary_en: Natural gas prices have fallen recently due to adjustments in weather forecasts. Changes in weather predictions directly affect market expectations for heating and power generation demand, thereby triggering price fluctuations. This article analyzes how weather factors dominate short-term natural gas trends and explores the interaction between inventory levels and supply-demand fundamentals. For investors focused on energy markets, understanding the sensitive relationship between weather forecasts and prices can help with trading timing and risk management. It is worth noting that the article also mentions the risk of further volatility that weather patterns may bring in the coming weeks.

items.title_cn: 建材分销商QXO对Beacon发起敌意收购
items.title_en: Building-Products Distributor QXO Launches Hostile Bid for Beacon
items.summary_cn: 建材分销领域突发敌意收购：QXO直接向Beacon股东发起要约，绕过管理层。此举可能重塑行业竞争格局，并引发其他分销商的连锁反应。值得关注的是，敌意收购在建材分销业罕见，若成功将创建新的巨头，失败则可能加速行业整合。投资者需留意双方后续博弈及监管反应。
items.summary_en: A hostile bid erupts in building-products distribution: QXO has launched a tender offer directly to Beacon's shareholders, bypassing management. This move could reshape industry competition and trigger chain reactions among other distributors. Notably, hostile takeovers are rare in this sector; success would create a new giant, while failure could accelerate consolidation. Investors should watch the ensuing battle and regulatory response.

items.title_cn: 英伟达遭调查后，预测市场仍认为黄仁勋短期内离职概率较低
items.title_en: Jensen Huang exit odds are low on prediction markets after Nvidia probe
items.summary_cn: 英伟达因监管调查面临不确定性，但预测市场交易员对CEO黄仁勋近期离职的定价概率依然较低。这反映出市场认为调查对黄仁勋个人职位的直接冲击有限，其领导地位仍被多数参与者看好。该信号值得关注，因为它提供了传统民调之外、用真金白银押注的实时预期，有助于判断英伟达治理风险的短期走向。
items.summary_en: Nvidia faces uncertainty from a regulatory probe, yet prediction market traders are still pricing relatively low odds that CEO Jensen Huang will depart in the near term. This suggests the market sees limited direct impact on Huang's position from the investigation, with most participants still confident in his leadership. The signal is worth watching because it offers real-money, real-time expectations beyond traditional polls, helping gauge the short-term trajectory of Nvidia's governance risk.

items.title_cn: 高盛CEO所罗门：尽管市场情绪波动，AI基础设施融资依然强劲
items.title_en: Goldman CEO Solomon says AI financing remains strong despite market jitters
items.summary_cn: 高盛首席执行官大卫·所罗门表示，尽管AI股票经历回调且数据中心面临政治不确定性，投资者对AI基础设施的融资热情依然旺盛。这一表态值得关注，因为它揭示了华尔街顶级投行对AI长期投资周期的判断：市场短期波动并未动摇资本对算力底座的押注，AI基建仍是资金配置的核心方向。
items.summary_en: Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon said investor appetite for AI infrastructure remains strong despite a reset in AI stocks and political uncertainty around data centers. This is noteworthy because it reveals how Wall Street's top investment bank views the long-term AI investment cycle: short-term market volatility has not shaken capital's bet on the computing foundation, and AI infrastructure remains a core allocation direction.

items.title_cn: 国会新格局下，医疗保健股前景为何不明朗
items.title_en: Why the prognosis for healthcare stocks is uncertain ahead of Congress’ new makeup
items.summary_cn: 随着民主党准备接管国会，医疗保健股可能难以找到上涨动力。投资者担忧民主党可能推动药品定价改革、扩大医保覆盖等政策，这些举措将直接影响制药商和保险公司的利润。同时，国会分裂可能导致政策僵局，增加不确定性。本文深入分析政治格局变化对医疗板块的潜在影响，帮助投资者理解政策风险与市场机会，值得关注。
items.summary_en: Healthcare stocks may struggle to gain momentum as Democrats prepare to take over Congress. Investors fear that Democrats could push for drug pricing reforms and expanded healthcare coverage, which would directly impact pharmaceutical and insurance profits. Meanwhile, a divided Congress could lead to policy gridlock, adding uncertainty. This article analyzes the potential impact of political shifts on the healthcare sector, helping investors understand policy risks and market opportunities.

items.title_cn: 伯克希尔哈撒韦第三季度利润下滑，股票回购规模却翻倍有余
items.title_en: Berkshire Hathaway more than doubles buybacks in third quarter as earnings decline
items.summary_cn: 伯克希尔哈撒韦第三季度运营利润与整体利润均出现下滑，但公司却将股票回购规模扩大了一倍以上。这一反常操作值得关注：在业绩承压时加速回购，既可能反映管理层认为股价被低估，也可能暗示巴菲特对现有投资机会缺乏信心，转而通过回购向股东返还现金。该动向对判断伯克希尔的资本配置策略及市场估值信号具有重要参考价值。
items.summary_en: Berkshire Hathaway reported declines in both operating and overall profits for the third quarter, yet more than doubled its share repurchases during the same period. This counterintuitive move is noteworthy: accelerating buybacks amid earnings pressure may signal that management views the stock as undervalued, or that Buffett sees few attractive investment opportunities and is returning cash to shareholders instead. The development offers valuable insight into Berkshire's capital allocation strategy and market valuation signals.

items.title_cn: 美联储戴利：美国人正处在“高通胀的跑步机”上，加息可能性犹存
items.title_en: Americans are on a 'treadmill of high inflation' and more rate hikes are likely, Fed's Daly says
items.summary_cn: 旧金山联储主席戴利将周五的就业报告称为“美国工人的好消息”，但同时指出通胀正对家庭财务造成压力。她警告美国人正处在“高通胀的跑步机”上，暗示美联储可能进一步加息。这一表态值得关注，因为它揭示了美联储在劳动力市场强劲与通胀顽固之间的政策权衡，直接影响未来利率路径和家庭经济负担。
items.summary_en: San Francisco Fed President Mary Daly called Friday's jobs report 'good news for American workers,' but noted the pressure inflation is exerting on household finances. She warned that Americans are on a 'treadmill of high inflation,' suggesting more rate hikes are likely. This is worth watching because it reveals the Fed's policy trade-off between a strong labor market and sticky inflation, directly affecting the future rate path and household economic burdens.

items.title_cn: AI“信用卡”成本攀升：CoreWeave债券收益率突破16%
items.title_en: The AI ‘credit card’ is getting costlier as CoreWeave bond yield tops 16%
items.summary_cn: CoreWeave债券收益率突破16%，凸显AI债务市场承压，投资者担忧数据中心建设放缓。这一高收益率不仅是企业融资成本上升的信号，更折射出市场对AI基础设施投资过热后的理性回调。值得关注的是，若数据中心扩张减速，将直接影响GPU租赁需求和AI算力供应链，进而波及整个科技行业的资本支出节奏。本文剖析了AI债务市场的压力来源及后续演变逻辑，为判断AI投资周期提供关键视角。
items.summary_en: CoreWeave's bond yield surpassing 16% highlights stress in the AI debt market, with investors worried about a slowdown in data center buildouts. This steep yield signals rising corporate financing costs and reflects a rational pullback after overheated AI infrastructure investment. Notably, slower data center expansion would directly affect GPU rental demand and the AI compute supply chain, potentially reshaping capex节奏 across the tech industry. The article analyzes the sources of stress in AI debt markets and what comes next, offering a key perspective on the AI investment cycle.

items.title_cn: 盘前异动股：Moderna、Airbnb、Cloudflare、Affirm等
items.title_en: Stocks making the biggest moves premarket: Moderna, Airbnb, Cloudflare, Affirm & more
items.summary_cn: 本文列出盘前交易中股价波动最大的几只个股，包括Moderna、Airbnb、Cloudflare、Affirm等。盘前异动往往反映市场对最新消息（如财报、指引、合作或监管动态）的即时反应，为当日交易提供重要线索。投资者可通过这些异动股快速捕捉市场情绪变化和潜在交易机会，尤其值得关注的是这些公司是否出现基本面转折或行业性趋势信号。
items.summary_en: This article lists the stocks with the largest premarket moves, including Moderna, Airbnb, Cloudflare, Affirm, and more. Premarket movers often reflect the market's immediate reaction to the latest news (such as earnings, guidance, partnerships, or regulatory developments), providing key clues for the trading day. Investors can use these movers to quickly gauge shifts in market sentiment and potential trading opportunities, with particular attention to whether these companies signal fundamental turning points or sector-wide trends.

items.title_cn: 纳斯达克指数跌入回调区间——历史走势揭示后续常见剧本
items.title_en: Nasdaq drops into correction territory — here’s what typically happens next
items.summary_cn: 纳斯达克综合指数正式进入回调区间（较近期高点下跌超10%），引发市场对后续走势的关注。本文梳理历史数据，揭示回调后常见的反弹模式与时间窗口，并分析当前宏观环境与过往周期的异同。对于投资者而言，理解历史规律有助于避免情绪化决策，把握潜在布局机会，同时警惕本次回调可能因高估值和利率环境而不同于以往。
items.summary_en: The Nasdaq Composite has officially entered correction territory (down more than 10% from its recent high), prompting investors to focus on what typically happens next. This article reviews historical data to reveal common rebound patterns and time windows after corrections, and analyzes how the current macro environment differs from past cycles. For investors, understanding historical patterns can help avoid emotional decisions and identify potential entry points, while remaining cautious that this correction may differ from previous ones due to elevated valuations and the interest rate environment.

items.title_cn: 亚洲股市借科技股反弹走高，油价下跌提振市场情绪
items.title_en: Asian Stocks Ride Tech Rally Higher as Oil Falls: Markets Wrap
items.summary_cn: 亚洲股市有望创下三个多月来最大的两日涨幅，科技股强势反弹与油价下跌共同提振了市场情绪。这轮上涨值得关注，因为它可能标志着投资者对科技板块的信心回升，以及能源成本下降对通胀压力的缓解，为区域市场带来短期支撑。
items.summary_en: Asian stocks are on track for their biggest two-day gain in over three months, as a strong tech rally and falling oil prices lift sentiment. This move is noteworthy as it may signal renewed investor confidence in the tech sector and easing inflation pressure from lower energy costs, offering short-term support for regional markets.

items.title_cn: 加息预期抵消油价下跌影响，金价小幅走低
items.title_en: Gold Edges Lower as Rate-Hike Bets Temper Impact of Lower Oil
items.summary_cn: 金价小幅下跌，因市场对再次加息的预期持续施压，抵消了油价因中东战争有望通过外交途径解决而延续跌势带来的支撑。值得关注的是，加息预期与地缘政治风险缓和的博弈正主导黄金短期走势，投资者需警惕利率路径变化对避险资产的重新定价。
items.summary_en: Gold edged lower as the probability of another interest rate hike continued to weigh on prices, countering support from oil's extended decline on hopes for a diplomatic resolution to the Middle East war. Investors should watch how the tug-of-war between rate-hike expectations and easing geopolitical risks is repricing safe-haven assets in the near term.

items.title_cn: 11月10日原油市场最新动态与分析：油价延续跌势，特朗普称无需进一步打击伊朗
items.title_en: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Nov. 10
items.summary_cn: 油价从8月以来最低收盘价继续下跌，此前美国总统特朗普表示无需对伊朗进行进一步打击，这缓解了市场对中东供应中断的担忧。值得关注的是，地缘政治风险溢价正在加速消退，叠加需求端疲软信号，原油市场短期承压格局进一步确认，投资者需警惕油价下行风险及对能源股和通胀预期的连锁影响。
items.summary_en: Oil extended declines from the lowest close since August after US President Donald Trump said further strikes on Iran wouldn't be necessary, easing concerns about Middle East supply disruptions. Notably, the geopolitical risk premium is fading rapidly, compounded by weak demand signals, confirming a near-term bearish tilt for crude. Investors should watch for downside risks to oil prices and their knock-on effects on energy stocks and inflation expectations.

items.title_cn: 新加坡推出央行黄金托管服务，抢占储备多元化先机
items.title_en: Singapore Launches Gold Vaulting Service for Central Banks
items.summary_cn: 新加坡推出面向外国央行及官方机构的黄金托管服务，旨在满足全球央行日益增长的黄金储备存储地多元化需求。此举凸显地缘政治风险下，各国寻求分散美元资产及黄金存放地（如从美英转移）的趋势。新加坡凭借政治稳定、金融基础设施完善及物流优势，有望成为区域黄金枢纽，值得关注其对全球黄金市场格局及央行储备策略的影响。
items.summary_en: Singapore has launched a gold vaulting service for foreign central banks and official institutions, aiming to meet growing demand for diversifying where bullion reserves are stored. This move highlights the trend of countries seeking to diversify away from USD assets and traditional gold storage locations (such as the US and UK) amid geopolitical risks. With its political stability, robust financial infrastructure, and logistics advantages, Singapore is positioned to become a regional gold hub. This development is noteworthy for its potential impact on the global gold market landscape and central bank reserve strategies.

items.title_cn: 日本30年期国债拍卖需求疲软，此前国债收益率曲线剧烈波动
items.title_en: Japan 30-Year Bond Sale Sees Weaker Demand After JGB Swings
items.summary_cn: 日本30年期国债拍卖需求疲软，因AI相关股票抛售引发收益率曲线剧烈波动，抑制了投资者风险偏好。此次拍卖结果凸显市场对超长期日债的谨慎情绪，可能加剧财政可持续性担忧，并影响全球债市情绪。值得关注的是，收益率波动与股市联动性增强，或迫使日本央行调整购债策略。
items.summary_en: Japan's 30-year government bond auction drew weak demand as sharp yield curve moves following an AI-related stock selloff dampened investor risk appetite. The soft auction highlights caution toward super-long JGBs, potentially fueling fiscal sustainability concerns and affecting global bond sentiment. Notably, increased yield volatility and stock market linkage may pressure the BOJ to adjust its bond-buying strategy.

items.title_cn: 美国中期选举后澳大利亚面临新现实
items.title_en: Australia Faces New US Reality After Midterms
items.summary_cn: 美国中期选举后民主党掌控国会，但特朗普在关税和军事行动上仍保留广泛单边权力。澳大利亚在贸易、关键矿产和AUKUS防务协议上的政策利益同时涉及国会和白宫，这给阿尔巴尼斯政府平衡对美关系带来新挑战。洛伊研究所执行主任迈克尔·富利洛夫在彭博节目中解析华盛顿政治格局变化对澳美关系的影响，值得关注。
items.summary_en: After the US midterms, Democrats control Congress, but Trump retains broad unilateral authority over tariffs and military operations. Australia's policy interests in trade, critical minerals, and the AUKUS defence pact run through both Congress and the White House, posing new challenges for the Albanese government in balancing relations with Washington. Michael Fullilove, Executive Director of the Lowy Institute, discusses the implications of the shifting political landscape for Australia-US relations on Bloomberg.

items.title_cn: 中国原油进口反弹至七个月新高，波斯湾供应恢复
items.title_en: China Oil Imports Rebound as More Crude Flows From Persian Gulf
items.summary_cn: 10月中国原油进口量升至七个月高位，主要受波斯湾地区出货量回升推动。这一反弹表明全球最大原油进口国的需求韧性，可能缓解市场对亚洲能源消费疲软的担忧。值得关注的是，进口增长是否持续将影响全球油市供需平衡及油价走势，尤其在地缘政治风险犹存的背景下。
items.summary_en: China's crude oil imports rose to a seven-month high in October, driven by a recovery in shipments from the Persian Gulf. The rebound signals resilient demand from the world's largest oil importer and may ease concerns over weak Asian energy consumption. It is worth watching whether the import growth sustains, as it could affect global oil market balance and prices, especially amid lingering geopolitical risks.

items.title_cn: 霍尔木兹海峡成品油流量回升，或缓解全球油市紧张局面
items.title_en: Rising Fuel Flows Through Hormuz May Help Ease Strained Market
items.summary_cn: 伊朗战争进入第九个月，波斯湾内成品油装载量持续上升，大部分经霍尔木兹海峡外运，为全球石油市场最紧张的环节之一带来些许缓解。这一变化值得关注，因为它直接关系到全球能源供应链的稳定性与油价走势，尤其是在地缘政治风险持续高企的背景下，海峡流量的恢复可能成为市场情绪与供需平衡的关键转折点。
items.summary_en: Nine months into the Iran war, refined product loadings within the Persian Gulf are rising, with most volumes exiting through the Strait of Hormuz, offering some relief to one of the tightest corners of the global oil market. This development is worth watching as it directly affects global energy supply chain stability and oil price trends. Against persistently high geopolitical risks, the recovery in Strait flows could prove a key turning point for market sentiment and supply-demand balance.

items.title_cn: 特朗普称FBI正调查英伟达CEO黄仁勋
items.title_en: Trump says FBI is ‘looking into’ Nvidia’s Jensen Huang
items.summary_cn: 美国前总统特朗普公开表示FBI正在调查英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋，此前该公司因CEO与一名中国间谍有婚外情的指控而受到震动。这一消息将全球最具价值的芯片公司推入地缘政治与法律风险的交汇点，值得关注的是调查是否会影响英伟达在AI芯片领域的主导地位及中美科技博弈走向。
items.summary_en: Former US President Trump publicly stated that the FBI is 'looking into' Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, following allegations that the chief executive had an affair with a Chinese spy. The news thrusts the world's most valuable chip company into the intersection of geopolitical and legal risks, raising questions about whether the investigation could affect Nvidia's dominance in AI chips and the trajectory of US-China tech rivalry.

items.title_cn: 被指中国间谍者与英伟达CEO有关联，曾向投资者推销AI芯片交易
items.title_en: Alleged Chinese spy linked to Nvidia chief pitched AI chip deals to investors
items.summary_cn: 报道称，被指控为中国间谍的Alice Huang曾向投资者吹嘘能获取英伟达GPU并自称与阿里巴巴有联系，还涉及与英伟达CEO的关联。此事凸显美国对华技术出口管制背景下，芯片供应链的敏感性与安全风险，值得关注其后续对英伟达、阿里及中美科技博弈的影响。
items.summary_en: Alice Huang, alleged to be a Chinese spy, reportedly boasted to investors about access to Nvidia GPUs and her connections to Alibaba, and is linked to Nvidia's CEO. The case highlights the sensitivity and security risks of the chip supply chain amid U.S. export controls on China, and is worth watching for its impact on Nvidia, Alibaba, and the broader U.S.-China tech rivalry.

items.title_cn: 全球为何过度依赖黄仁勋？
items.title_en: How the world became too reliant on Jensen Huang
items.summary_cn: 本文剖析了英伟达CEO黄仁勋个人影响力与公司乃至全球科技供应链深度绑定的现象。文章指出，黄仁勋的困境警示我们：对大型企业而言，单一故障点绝非好事。这种过度依赖不仅放大了个体风险，也暴露了全球AI芯片产业生态的脆弱性，值得投资者与政策制定者深思。
items.summary_en: This article examines how Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's personal influence has become deeply intertwined with the company and the global tech supply chain. It argues that Huang's travails serve as a reminder that a single point of failure is never good for a big company. This over-reliance amplifies individual risk and exposes the fragility of the global AI chip ecosystem, offering valuable insights for investors and policymakers.

items.title_cn: 间谍丑闻后，黄仁勋还能保住英伟达CEO之位吗？
items.title_en: Can Jensen Huang survive as Nvidia’s CEO after spy scandal?
items.summary_cn: 英伟达联合创始人黄仁勋正面临间谍丑闻的冲击，而这家全球第二大芯片公司却缺乏明确的继任者。本文深入剖析这一危机对黄仁勋领导地位的潜在影响，以及英伟达在权力交接上的脆弱性。值得一读，因为它揭示了科技巨头在创始人依赖与治理风险之间的深层矛盾。
items.summary_en: Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang is facing fallout from a spy scandal, yet the world's second-largest chipmaker has no clear successor. This article examines the potential impact on Huang's leadership and Nvidia's vulnerability in leadership transition. A must-read for its insight into the deep tension between founder reliance and governance risk at tech giants.

items.title_cn: 特朗普、普京与短暂战争幻觉
items.title_en: Trump, Putin and the short war illusion
items.summary_cn: 本文对比特朗普与普京发动的失败战争，揭示大国领导人常陷入“短期战争”幻觉，误判对手与战争代价。文章进一步追问：习近平能否从这些教训中做出正确判断？值得关注的是，它直指决策认知偏差与地缘政治风险，对理解当前国际局势具有启发意义。
items.summary_en: This article contrasts the failed wars launched by Trump and Putin, revealing how leaders of major powers often fall into the illusion of a 'short war,' misjudging opponents and costs. It further asks whether Xi Jinping can draw the right lessons from these failures. Worth reading for its insight into cognitive biases in decision-making and geopolitical risks, offering valuable perspective on current international affairs.

items.title_cn: 日本经验启示世界：备灾的关键在于建立公民信任
items.title_en: Japan can tell the world what really matters when prepping
items.summary_cn: 日本在备灾领域的实践表明，仅仅呼吁民众囤积物资远远不够，真正的核心在于构建“公民可信度”这一社会资本。文章深入剖析日本如何通过长期教育、社区协作和制度透明，将备灾从个人行为升华为社会共识，从而在灾难来临时实现高效响应。这一视角跳出了传统物资储备的局限，揭示了备灾背后更深层的社会治理逻辑，对全球各国具有重要借鉴意义。
items.summary_en: Japan's experience in disaster preparedness shows that telling people to stockpile supplies is far from enough; the real key lies in building 'civic credibility' as social capital. The article analyzes how Japan, through long-term education, community collaboration, and institutional transparency, elevates preparedness from individual action to social consensus, enabling efficient response when disasters strike. This perspective goes beyond traditional material stockpiling and reveals the deeper logic of social governance behind preparedness, offering valuable lessons for countries worldwide.

items.title_cn: 中国前10个月贸易顺差突破1万亿美元，全年或创纪录加剧贸易紧张
items.title_en: China’s trade surplus exceeds $1tn for first 10 months of year
items.summary_cn: 中国前10个月贸易顺差突破1万亿美元，全年有望创下新纪录。这一趋势可能加剧与主要贸易伙伴的摩擦，尤其在美国和欧盟对中国出口依赖度上升的背景下。值得关注的是，顺差扩大反映内需疲软与出口韧性并存，可能引发更多贸易保护措施，影响全球供应链和汇率政策走向。
items.summary_en: China’s trade surplus exceeded $1 trillion in the first 10 months of the year, putting it on course for a new annual record. This trend could intensify tensions with major trading partners, especially as the US and EU grow more dependent on Chinese exports. The widening surplus reflects weak domestic demand alongside export resilience, potentially triggering more trade protection measures and affecting global supply chains and exchange rate policy.

items.title_cn: 特朗普“和平委员会”警告加沙爆发“紧急人道主义危机”
items.title_en: Trump’s Board of Peace warns of ‘immediate humanitarian emergency’ in Gaza
items.summary_cn: 特朗普设立的“和平委员会”首次就加沙局势发出紧急警告，指出洪水已使巴勒斯坦人陷入不安全境地，而以色列允许进入的援助物资严重不足。该表态值得关注，因为它来自特朗普亲自推动的机构，而非传统国际组织，暗示美国内部对加沙人道灾难的容忍度可能正在变化，也为观察特朗普第二任期的中东政策提供了新信号。
items.summary_en: Trump's Board of Peace has issued its first urgent warning on Gaza, stating that flooding has left Palestinians in unsafe conditions and that Israel is allowing insufficient aid into the territory. This statement is noteworthy because it comes from a body personally promoted by Trump rather than a traditional international organization, suggesting that tolerance for the humanitarian catastrophe in Gaza may be shifting within U.S. circles and offering a new signal for observing Trump's Middle East policy in his second term.

items.title_cn: Anthropic据报推进IPO计划，本周或设定估值区间
items.title_en: Anthropic reportedly plans to move forward with IPO plans
items.summary_cn: 据《华尔街日报》报道，AI公司Anthropic计划推进IPO，预计本周设定估值区间。作为OpenAI的主要竞争对手，Anthropic的上市动向备受关注，其估值将反映市场对生成式AI商业化前景的信心。若成行，这将是AI领域迄今规模最大的IPO之一，值得投资者和科技从业者密切关注。
items.summary_en: The Wall Street Journal reports that AI company Anthropic plans to move forward with its IPO and is expected to set its valuation range this week. As a major competitor to OpenAI, Anthropic's listing move is closely watched, and its valuation will reflect market confidence in the commercialization prospects of generative AI. If realized, it would be one of the largest IPOs in the AI sector to date, warranting close attention from investors and tech professionals.

items.title_cn: 黄仁勋被曝一年前聘请曾处理多起名人性丑闻的公关公司
items.title_en: Jensen Huang reportedly engaged a PR firm with a history of handling high-profile sex scandals a year ago
items.summary_cn: 据《连线》报道，英伟达CEO黄仁勋在2025年10月《纽约时报》披露其与Alice Huang的商业往来后不久，便聘请了一家以处理高知名度性丑闻著称的公关公司。这一举动暗示黄仁勋团队对相关报道可能引发的声誉风险高度警惕，并试图借助危机公关经验进行应对。该事件值得关注，因为它涉及全球最具影响力的科技领袖之一，且公关策略的选择可能影响公众对英伟达领导层的信任。
items.summary_en: According to Wired, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang engaged a PR firm known for handling high-profile sex scandals shortly after an October 2025 New York Times report described Alice Huang's business dealings with him. The move suggests Huang's team was highly alert to reputational risks from the report and sought crisis PR expertise. The story matters because it involves one of the world's most influential tech leaders, and the PR strategy could affect public trust in Nvidia's leadership.

items.title_cn: 做空机构在英伟达间谍丑闻爆发前六个月已警示黄仁勋与疑似中国间谍关系密切
items.title_en: A short seller flagged Nvidia CEO’s ties to a suspected Chinese spy six months before the scandal
items.summary_cn: 做空机构Culper Research在英伟达间谍丑闻公开前六个月，就已质疑CEO黄仁勋与一名中国高管关系异常密切。这一提前预警揭示了英伟达在供应链与人事背景审查上的潜在漏洞，也凸显做空机构在科技巨头风险披露中的预警作用。值得关注的是，该事件可能影响英伟达在华业务合规性及投资者信心，并引发对科技公司高管对外联系监管的讨论。
items.summary_en: Short seller Culper Research questioned CEO Jensen Huang's unusually close ties with a Chinese executive six months before Nvidia's spy scandal became public. This early warning reveals potential gaps in Nvidia's supply chain and personnel background checks, and highlights the role of short sellers in flagging risks at tech giants. The case could affect Nvidia's China compliance and investor confidence, and spark debate over oversight of executives' foreign contacts.

items.title_cn: 英伟达因黄仁勋涉华间谍调查遭诉讼竞赛，股价大跌
items.title_en: The race is on to sue Nvidia
items.summary_cn: 英伟达董事会调查黄仁勋与疑似中国间谍的关系后，股价下跌超4%。证券法专家指出，公司此前坚称一切“正常”的表态可能演变为代价高昂的法律问题。此案凸显科技巨头在地缘政治敏感关系中的合规风险，值得关注其后续诉讼进展及对股价的潜在冲击。
items.summary_en: Nvidia's stock fell over 4% after its board opened an investigation into Jensen Huang's relationship with a suspected Chinese spy. A securities law expert says the company's earlier insistence that everything was 'normal' could become a costly legal problem. This case highlights compliance risks for tech giants in geopolitically sensitive relationships and is worth watching for litigation developments and potential stock impact.

items.title_cn: 英伟达争议持续发酵：黄仁勋临时取消ElevenLabs峰会演讲，此前已退出Anthropic活动
items.title_en: Jensen Huang pulls out of ElevenLabs Summit amid Nvidia controversy
items.summary_cn: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋在英伟达陷入争议之际，接连取消ElevenLabs峰会及Anthropic活动的出席计划。此举凸显AI芯片巨头正面临日益增大的舆论与监管压力，其高管公开露面的策略或随之调整。值得关注的是，黄仁勋的连续退出是否意味着英伟达正在重新评估与AI初创企业的公开关联，以及这是否会影响其生态合作节奏。
items.summary_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has withdrawn from the ElevenLabs Summit and an earlier Anthropic event amid controversy surrounding the chip giant. The back-to-back cancellations highlight growing public and regulatory pressure on Nvidia, potentially signaling a shift in how its executives engage publicly. It is worth watching whether Huang's withdrawals reflect a broader reassessment of Nvidia's visible ties to AI startups and whether they could affect the pace of its ecosystem collaborations.

items.title_cn: Anthropic发布Mythos与Fable新模型，RSI担忧中聚焦编码推理与视觉能力提升
items.title_en: Anthropic releases new Mythos and Fable models amid RSI concerns
items.summary_cn: Anthropic推出Mythos和Fable两款新模型，宣称在编码、推理、视觉及用户沟通清晰度上均有改进。值得关注的是，发布正值业界对递归自我改进（RSI）潜在风险日益担忧之际，这既展示了AI能力的持续跃升，也凸显了安全与可控性议题的紧迫性。新模型的实际表现与Anthropic如何平衡创新与风险，将成关键看点。
items.summary_en: Anthropic has released two new models, Mythos and Fable, claiming improvements in coding, reasoning, vision, and clearer communication with users. Notably, the launch comes amid growing concerns over recursive self-improvement (RSI), highlighting both the rapid advancement of AI capabilities and the urgency of safety and controllability issues. How the new models perform in practice and how Anthropic balances innovation with risk will be key to watch.

items.title_cn: 黄仁勋被曝与疑似中国间谍有染，英伟达在华野心面临审视
items.title_en: Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy puts Nvidia’s China ambitions under scrutiny
items.summary_cn: 报道称英伟达CEO黄仁勋与一名疑似中国间谍的女性有婚外情，此事可能复杂化英伟达游说美国政府放宽芯片出口限制的努力，并危及其在中国这一利润丰厚AI市场的准入。该事件凸显科技巨头在地缘政治敏感期面临的高管个人风险与商业利益交织的困境，值得关注其对美中芯片博弈及英伟达全球战略的潜在冲击。
items.summary_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is alleged to have had an affair with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy, a revelation that could complicate the company's lobbying efforts to ease U.S. chip export restrictions and jeopardize its access to China's lucrative AI market. The incident highlights the intersection of executive personal risks and business interests for tech giants amid geopolitical tensions, and is worth watching for its potential impact on the U.S.-China chip rivalry and Nvidia's global strategy.

items.title_cn: Meta发布Muse Ember：一款面向智能体执行的轻量级新模型
items.title_en: Meta releases Muse Ember, a new lightweight model for agent execution
items.summary_cn: Meta推出轻量级模型Muse Ember，专为智能体执行任务设计，每百万输入token仅10美分，价格远低于Haiku、Luna等前沿竞品。该模型以极致性价比切入AI智能体赛道，有望大幅降低自动化工作流的推理成本，推动智能体应用从实验走向规模化落地。对于关注AI成本结构与部署效率的团队而言，Ember的定价策略和轻量定位值得深入评估。
items.summary_en: Meta has launched Muse Ember, a lightweight model purpose-built for agent execution, priced at just 10 cents per million input tokens—significantly cheaper than frontier competitors like Haiku and Luna. By undercutting rivals on cost, Ember could dramatically lower the inference expenses of automated workflows and accelerate the shift of agentic applications from experimentation to scale. For teams focused on AI cost structure and deployment efficiency, Ember's pricing and lightweight positioning merit close evaluation.

items.title_cn: 数据中心遭抵制，症结或许在电力而非科技巨头
items.title_en: The backlash about data centers might really just be about electricity
items.summary_cn: 作者走访全球最大数据中心枢纽弗吉尼亚州阿什本后指出，科技巨头将数据中心遭抵制归咎于文化战争，但实地观察表明，公众不满的根源更多在于电力这一物理现实：数据中心对电力的巨大需求以及电网连接或现场发电带来的实际影响，难以被公关手段掩盖。本文揭示抵制背后被忽视的电力症结，值得关注AI基础设施扩张的社会成本。
items.summary_en: After visiting Ashburn, Virginia—the world's largest data center hub—the author argues that while Big Tech frames the backlash against data centers as a culture war, the real driver is electricity. The industry's enormous power demand and the physical consequences of grid connections or on-site generation cannot be offset by image campaigns. This piece reveals the overlooked electrical roots of the resistance, offering crucial insight into the social costs of AI infrastructure expansion.

items.title_cn: 佩洛西继任者准备监管AI：加州参议员Scott Wiener赢得国会席位，或成联邦AI政策关键人物
items.title_en: Nancy Pelosi’s replacement is ready to regulate AI
items.summary_cn: 加州参议员Scott Wiener曾起草前沿AI监管法案SB 1047（被州长否决）和SB 53（已签署），如今赢得佩洛西留下的旧金山国会席位。他引用METR报告称Anthropic可能已实现递归自我改进，警告AI进展可能失控，并希望国会今年采取行动但未果。Wiener已对AI政策产生实际影响，其法案启发了联邦立法提案，未来可能在联邦AI政策制定中发挥关键作用。
items.summary_en: California State Senator Scott Wiener, author of frontier AI bills SB 1047 (vetoed) and SB 53 (signed), has won Nancy Pelosi's open San Francisco congressional seat. Citing a METR report suggesting Anthropic may have achieved recursive self-improvement, he warns AI progress could spin out of control and says Congress must act. Wiener has already influenced AI policy, and his bills have inspired federal proposals, positioning him as a key player in setting federal AI policy.

items.title_cn: AI气候声明空洞无力，英伟达遭调查
items.title_en: The Download: empty AI climate claims, and an Nvidia investigation
items.summary_cn: 本期《下载》聚焦两大议题：一是加州大学洛杉矶分校法学院杰出顾问、加州空气资源委员会前主席Mary Nichols与可持续研究公司Dual Citizen创始人Jeremy Tamanini联合撰文，指出AI行业对气候贡献的乐观声明缺乏实质证据，各国在联合国气候大会上应警惕空洞承诺；二是介绍一位生态学家揭示热带雨林复苏的隐形网络，热带森林储存了全球约40%的陆地碳，对气候至关重要。文章兼具批判性与前沿性，值得关注AI气候影响与生态保护的读者阅读。
items.summary_en: This edition of The Download covers two key topics: First, Mary Nichols, distinguished counsel at UCLA School of Law and former chair of the California Air Resources Board, and Jeremy Tamanini, founder of sustainability research firm Dual Citizen, argue that AI companies' optimistic claims about helping address climate change lack substantive evidence, and countries at the UN climate conference should be wary of empty promises. Second, it introduces an ecologist revealing the invisible networks that revive rainforests—tropical forests store about 40% of land-based carbon and are crucial for the climate. The piece offers both critical insight and cutting-edge reporting, making it valuable for readers interested in AI's climate impact and ecological conservation.

items.title_cn: AI如何重塑特种化学品研发：对话路博润IT副总裁
items.title_en: Innovating with AI in the special chemicals industry
items.summary_cn: 路博润正构建连接业务流程、数据平台与云基础设施的数字底座，让数据科学家与化学家组成“融合团队”，在物理实验前完成假设测试与建模。其核心洞察是：AI不是替代科学判断，而是赋能科学家更快试错、更优决策，同时兼顾产品性能与可持续性。这一“融合团队+小规模试点”的落地路径，为传统材料企业提供了可复用的AI转型方法论。
items.summary_en: Lubrizol is building a digital foundation that connects business processes, data platforms, and cloud infrastructure, enabling 'fusion teams' of data scientists and chemists to test hypotheses and model possibilities before physical experiments. The key insight: AI doesn't replace scientific judgment—it gives scientists better tools to iterate faster, make better-informed decisions, and develop more sustainable materials without compromising performance. This 'fusion team + small pilot' approach offers a reusable AI transformation playbook for traditional materials companies.

items.title_cn: AI的气候红利尚未兑现：科技巨头的承诺与现实差距
items.title_en: The climate case for AI has not been made
items.summary_cn: 在联合国气候大会上，AI成为焦点议题，东道主呼吁各国确保AI支持气候行动。然而，尽管OpenAI CEO等科技领袖宣称AI将“解决气候问题”，谷歌可持续主管预测AI到2030年可减排5%-10%，但全球各行业远未充分利用该技术实现温室气体减排。伦敦政经学院等机构研究估算，到2035年AI每年或可助减排32-54亿吨CO₂，主要集中于电力、肉奶业和交通领域，但这一潜力仍停留在预测层面。本文揭示AI气候承诺与实际行动之间的巨大鸿沟，值得关注科技行业在气候危机中的真实角色。
items.summary_en: At the UN climate conference, AI is a dominant topic, with the host urging countries to ensure AI supports climate action. However, despite claims from tech leaders like OpenAI's CEO that AI will 'fix the climate' and Google's sustainability head predicting 5-10% emission cuts by 2030, industries worldwide are far from harnessing the technology to actually reduce greenhouse gases. A peer-reviewed study estimates AI could help cut 3.2-5.4 billion tons of CO₂ annually by 2035, mainly in power, meat and dairy, and vehicles—but these projections remain unfulfilled. This article exposes the gap between AI's climate promises and real-world action, making it essential reading for understanding tech's true role in the climate crisis.

items.title_cn: 今日下载：人形机器人打扫房屋，三星为AI热潮建造芯片厂
items.title_en: The Download: a humanoid cleans house and Samsung builds for the AI boom
items.summary_cn: 本期《今日下载》带来两个值得关注的科技动态：一是记者亲身体验了旧金山Tau Robotics公司的人形机器人上门清洁服务，虽然目前仍需远程人工操控，但已让人窥见未来家庭自动化的雏形；二是三星正大规模建设新的半导体制造园区，以满足生成式AI模型对专用内存芯片的激增需求。这两条新闻分别从消费端和基础设施端揭示了AI与机器人技术如何逐步渗透日常生活与产业格局，值得读者关注技术落地的真实进度与瓶颈。
items.summary_en: This edition of The Download covers two notable tech developments: a reporter's firsthand experience with a humanoid robot cleaning service from San Francisco startup Tau Robotics—currently teleoperated by humans but offering a glimpse of future home automation—and Samsung's massive new semiconductor manufacturing campus built to meet soaring demand for specialized memory chips powering generative AI models. Together, these stories reveal how AI and robotics are gradually permeating daily life and industrial infrastructure, highlighting both the progress and the current limitations of real-world deployment.

items.title_cn: 我观看了一台人形机器人打扫我的公寓，感觉像是提前体验了未来
items.title_en: I watched a humanoid robot clean my apartment. It felt like a taste of the future.
items.summary_cn: 作者以普通用户身份体验了旧金山初创公司Tau Robotics的人形机器人保洁服务。机器人目前由人工远程操控，通过摄像头采集数据以训练未来自主模型。服务价格虽低（每小时30美元），但机器人动作缓慢，全程围观不如自己动手。文章以亲历者视角揭示了当前人形机器人服务的真实水平：物理能力已具备，但效率与自主性仍处早期，数据积累才是商业逻辑的核心。值得一读，因为它剥离了宣传话术，呈现了AI机器人落地家庭场景的现状与瓶颈。
items.summary_en: The author experienced a humanoid robot cleaning service from San Francisco startup Tau Robotics as an ordinary customer. The robots are currently teleoperated by humans and collect data via cameras to train future autonomous models. Despite the low price ($30/hour), the robots are slow, making it more efficient to clean yourself if you watch the whole time. The first-person account reveals the reality of current humanoid robot services: physical capability exists, but efficiency and autonomy are still early-stage, with data collection as the core business logic. It's worth reading because it strips away hype and presents the current state and bottlenecks of AI robots entering home environments.

items.title_cn: 得克萨斯州脆弱的AI繁荣与能源政策转向
items.title_en: The Download: Texas’s fragile AI boom and energy policy shifts
items.summary_cn: 本期《下载》聚焦美国中期选举后AI与能源格局的潜在剧变。得州作为AI数据中心建设重镇，因民主党横扫州级选举并主打数据中心议题，其大规模AI基建计划可能受阻，加剧全美AI扩张停滞的担忧。同时，联邦层面气候与能源立法在特朗普任内难有作为，政策走向值得关注。
items.summary_en: This edition of The Download examines the potential upheaval in AI and energy landscapes after the US midterm elections. Texas, a major hub for AI data center construction, may see its large-scale AI infrastructure plans hindered as Democrats swept state elections with data centers as a central issue, heightening concerns over a nationwide AI buildout stall. Meanwhile, major federal climate and energy legislation is unlikely under Trump, making policy trends worth watching.

items.title_cn: 派拉蒙CEO：AI或成现代史上最大创意解放，影响将超越CGI
items.title_en: David Ellison says AI could be the ‘biggest creative unlock in modern history’
items.summary_cn: 派拉蒙Skydance CEO大卫·埃里森在财报电话会上表示，AI对电影行业的影响可能超越CGI，成为现代史上最大的创意解放。他将AI比作90年代初CGI和数字合成技术的诞生，后者催生了《侏罗纪公园》等经典。这一表态来自好莱坞主流制片厂掌舵人，标志着传统影视巨头对AI态度的关键转变，值得关注AI将如何重塑内容生产流程与创意边界。
items.summary_en: David Ellison, CEO of Paramount Skydance, said on the latest earnings call that AI could have a bigger impact on film than CGI, calling it potentially 'the biggest creative unlock in modern history.' He compared AI to the advent of CGI and digital compositing in the early 90s, which gave birth to films like Jurassic Park. The remark from a major Hollywood studio chief signals a key shift in how traditional media giants view AI, making it worth watching how AI will reshape content production and creative boundaries.

items.title_cn: 中国能从黄仁勋身上得到什么？
items.title_en: What could China get from Jensen Huang?
items.summary_cn: 本文探讨了英伟达CEO黄仁勋作为外国对手（中国）高价值目标的原因。英伟达芯片是美国AI技术的基石，供不应求，且公司已向AI前沿实验室、新兴云服务商等投资约990亿美元。黄仁勋与特朗普关系密切，其联合创始人兼长期CEO的身份使其成为情报搜集或人才挖角的关键目标。文章揭示了美国AI供应链的脆弱性及地缘政治博弈中企业领袖的战略价值。
items.summary_en: This article explores why Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang would be a valuable target for a foreign adversary like China. Nvidia's chips are the bedrock of US AI technology and demand has consistently outpaced supply. The company has invested about $99 billion in frontier AI labs, neoclouds, and infrastructure companies. Huang's close ties to President Trump and his role as cofounder and longtime CEO make him a key target for intelligence gathering or talent recruitment. The piece highlights the fragility of the US AI supply chain and the strategic value of corporate leaders in geopolitical competition.

items.title_cn: 特朗普回应黄仁勋绯闻：他早已知情？白宫记者会实录
items.title_en: Here’s what Trump said he knew about Jensen Huang
items.summary_cn: 特朗普在白宫记者会上被问及对英伟达CEO黄仁勋与疑似中国间谍爱丽丝·黄婚外情的了解程度。黄仁勋周末承认对妻子不忠，英伟达已启动调查。《纽约时报》此前报道称，特朗普约一年前就听取过相关情报简报。本文记录了特朗普的回应，揭示科技巨头领袖丑闻如何牵动政治神经，值得关注权力与科技交织的敏感地带。
items.summary_en: At a White House press briefing, President Trump was asked about his knowledge of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's affair with an alleged Chinese spy, Alice Huang. Huang admitted this weekend to being 'unfaithful' to his wife, and Nvidia has opened an investigation. The New York Times previously reported that Trump had been briefed on the intelligence 'roughly a year ago.' This article captures Trump's response, highlighting how a tech leader's scandal intersects with politics and national security.

items.title_cn: 英伟达间谍丑闻全解析：CEO黄仁勋婚外情牵出中国间谍案
items.title_en: Everything we know so far about the Nvidia spy scandal targeting CEO Jensen Huang
items.summary_cn: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋承认与Megaspeed高管Alice Huang的婚外情，而美国情报报告指认Alice Huang为中国国家安全部间谍。此事发生在英伟达深度嵌入特朗普政府AI战略、市值超4万亿美元、并资助Coreweave等AI云公司的背景下。尽管英伟达声称无证据表明国家安全或公司机密受损，但调查仍在持续。本文汇总了事件全貌、特朗普表态、中国可能获取的信息以及AI未来与CEO私生活的关联，值得关注是因为它揭示了地缘政治、科技巨头与个人丑闻的交织。
items.summary_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has acknowledged an affair with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, whom US intelligence reports identified as a spy for China's Ministry of State Security. This unfolds as Nvidia is deeply embedded in the Trump administration's AI push, has a market cap over $4 trillion, and finances AI companies like Coreweave. Although Nvidia says it has 'no reason to believe' national security or company secrets were compromised, the investigation continues. This roundup covers the full story, Trump's remarks, what China could gain, and why AI's future hinges on the CEO's personal life—worth reading because it reveals the intersection of geopolitics, tech giants, and personal scandal.

items.title_cn: 苹果推出50美元AI使用包，部分智能功能需额外付费
items.title_en: Apple’s $50 Intelligence Usage Packs extend access to some AI features
items.summary_cn: 苹果针对依赖云端AI模型（如OpenAI、Google Gemini）的Apple Intelligence功能推出“智能使用包”，Logic Pro用户可一次性支付49.99美元购买额外使用额度。此举标志着苹果开始对高成本AI功能探索按量付费模式，值得关注的是其如何平衡免费体验与云端推理成本，以及这一策略会否扩展到更多专业应用。
items.summary_en: Apple has introduced 'Intelligence Usage Packs' for Apple Intelligence features that rely on cloud-based AI models from OpenAI or Google Gemini. Logic Pro users can now pay a one-time $49.99 fee for additional usage. This marks Apple's exploration of pay-per-use models for costly AI features, raising questions about balancing free access with cloud inference costs and whether the strategy will expand to more pro apps.

items.title_cn: Anthropic发布Claude Fable与Mythos 5.2新模型，宣称可攻克理论物理难题
items.title_en: Anthropic launches new Claude Fable and Mythos 5.2 models
items.summary_cn: Anthropic推出Claude Fable 5.2和Mythos 5.2两款新模型，宣称在编程、推理和视觉能力上均有提升，且生成速度超过5.1版本。Fable 5.2擅长高难度软件工程，能编排智能体团队并处理长期项目，甚至解决了两个开放理论物理问题。这一进展值得关注，因为它标志着AI从辅助编码向自主科研攻关迈出实质性一步，若属实将重新定义AI在基础科学发现中的角色。
items.summary_en: Anthropic has launched two new models, Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, claiming improvements in coding, reasoning, and vision, with faster output than the 5.1 versions. Fable 5.2 excels at challenging software engineering, can orchestrate agent teams and handle long-running projects, and has even solved two open theoretical physics problems. This is worth watching because it marks a substantive step from AI-assisted coding toward autonomous scientific problem-solving—if borne out, it redefines AI's role in basic scientific discovery.

items.title_cn: Instagram推出AI滤镜生成器Effect Builder，用提示词打造专属故事滤镜
items.title_en: Instagram’s Effect Builder makes new filters from AI prompts
items.summary_cn: Instagram正式上线Effect Builder功能，允许美国18岁以上用户通过文字提示词和参考图，利用AI生成自定义故事滤镜。用户可上传照片预览效果并迭代修改，甚至让AI自动优化提示词。这是Instagram继Edits应用登陆macOS后，在AI创作工具上的又一重要布局，标志着社交平台滤镜从预设模板向个性化AI生成转型，值得关注其对创作者生态和内容表达方式的影响。
items.summary_en: Instagram has launched Effect Builder, a tool that lets US users over 18 generate custom Story filters via text prompts and style reference images. Users can preview effects on their own photos, refine results with follow-up prompts, and even let Instagram's AI rewrite their prompts. Following the Edits app's macOS expansion, this marks another major AI creation push for Instagram, signaling a shift from preset filter templates to personalized AI-generated effects—worth watching for its impact on creator workflows and content expression.

items.title_cn: AI的未来竟系于黄仁勋的私生活？
items.title_en: The future of AI hinges on… Jensen Huang’s sex life?
items.summary_cn: 本文以讽刺笔调揭露英伟达CEO黄仁勋与Megaspeed高管Alice Huang的暧昧关系，后者公司恰在两人被拍到同框后获得48亿美元紧俏芯片。文章质疑黄仁勋的判断力，并暗示这起“国家安全事件”可能影响AI芯片供应链的公正性。值得一看，因为它以尖锐视角拷问科技巨头权力与私德的边界。
items.summary_en: This satirical piece exposes Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, whose company secured $4.8 billion in scarce chips around the time they were photographed together in a Taipei bar. It questions Huang's judgment and suggests this 'national security incident' may compromise the integrity of the AI chip supply chain. Worth reading for its sharp take on the boundary between tech power and personal conduct.

items.title_cn: 马丁·艾米斯：一份鉴赏
items.title_en: Martin Amis: An Appreciation
items.summary_cn: 本文是对英国作家马丁·艾米斯的纪念与赏析。文章以2007年的一次相遇为切入点，回顾了艾米斯作为“伦敦三部曲”作者的生平与创作。他以其独特的文体风格、对当代社会的尖锐观察和对语言边界的不断探索而闻名。这篇鉴赏不仅勾勒了艾米斯的文学成就，也展现了他作为公共知识分子的复杂形象，对于理解20世纪末至21世纪初英国文学图景具有重要价值。
items.summary_en: This piece is a memorial appreciation of British writer Martin Amis. Opening with an encounter in 2007, it revisits the life and work of the author of the London Trilogy. Known for his distinctive prose style, sharp observations of contemporary society, and constant exploration of linguistic boundaries, Amis is portrayed as a complex public intellectual. This appreciation not only outlines his literary achievements but also illuminates his significance in understanding the landscape of British literature from the late 20th to the early 21st century.

items.title_cn: 书评：《NB by J.C.》，詹姆斯·坎贝尔著
items.title_en: Book Review: ‘NB by J.C.,’ by James Campbell
items.summary_cn: 詹姆斯·坎贝尔在《泰晤士报文学增刊》的专栏“NB”以犀利、博学又风趣著称。本书收录其多年随笔，涵盖文学轶事、作家八卦与批评洞见，既有对经典的严肃审视，也不乏令人会心一笑的冷幽默。对于热爱文学批评与出版文化的读者，这是一部值得细品的智慧集锦，展现了当代最敏锐的文学编辑之一如何以短小篇幅传递深刻观察。
items.summary_en: James Campbell's 'NB' column in the Times Literary Supplement is known for its wit, erudition, and sharp insight. This collection gathers years of his essays, blending literary anecdotes, writerly gossip, and critical acumen—ranging from serious appraisals of classics to wry humor. For readers who relish literary criticism and publishing culture, this is a rewarding trove of wisdom from one of today's most perceptive literary editors, showing how short-form commentary can deliver profound observations.

items.title_cn: 《黑暗中的火焰》：凯·雷德菲尔德·贾米森转向疗愈者
items.title_en: In ‘Fires in the Dark,’ Kay Redfield Jamison Turns to Healers
items.summary_cn: 凯·雷德菲尔德·贾米森曾以自身精神疾病经历写作，改变了许多人的生活，却也遭遇大量退稿。在新书《黑暗中的火焰》中，她将目光转向疗愈者——那些帮助他人走出心理黑暗的人。本书融合个人叙事与对疗愈本质的深刻探索，追问何为真正的治愈、疗愈者与被疗愈者之间的纽带如何形成。贾米森以临床心理学家与亲历者的双重身份，为心理健康领域带来罕见而动人的洞察，值得每一位关注心灵健康的人阅读。
items.summary_en: Kay Redfield Jamison, who changed many lives by writing about her own experience with mental illness while facing much rejection, turns her attention to healers in her new book, ‘Fires in the Dark’—those who help others out of psychological darkness. Blending personal narrative with a profound exploration of the nature of healing, the book asks what true healing means and how the bond between healer and healed is formed. Writing as both a clinical psychologist and someone who has lived through mental illness, Jamison offers rare and moving insight into mental health, making this essential reading for anyone who cares about the well-being of the mind.

items.title_cn: 侦探小说《谁的尸体？》百年诞辰：多萝西·L·塞耶斯与侦探俱乐部的传奇
items.title_en: The Detective Novel ‘Whose Body?,’ by Dorothy L. Sayers, Turns 100
items.summary_cn: 多萝西·L·塞耶斯的《谁的尸体？》迎来百年诞辰，这部1923年问世的作品塑造了贵族侦探彼得·温西勋爵，并开创了侦探小说的新范式。塞耶斯参与创立侦探俱乐部，与阿加莎·克里斯蒂等巨匠共同奠定了黄金时代推理的规则与荣光。本书不仅情节精巧，更以幽默笔触和人性洞察，让侦探小说升华为文学。百年后重读，依然能感受其开创性魅力与持久生命力，是推理迷不可错过的经典。
items.summary_en: Dorothy L. Sayers's 'Whose Body?' turns 100. Published in 1923, it introduced Lord Peter Wimsey and helped redefine detective fiction. Sayers co-founded the Detection Club with Agatha Christie and others, establishing the ground rules of the Golden Age of detective fiction. The novel is not only ingeniously plotted but also infused with wit and human insight, elevating the genre to literature. A century later, it remains a groundbreaking and enduring classic that no mystery fan should miss.

items.title_cn: 书评：《唐·卡斯穆罗》，马查多·德·阿西斯著
items.title_en: Book Review: ‘Dom Casmurro,’ by Machado de Assis
items.summary_cn: 《唐·卡斯穆罗》是巴西文学巨匠马查多·德·阿西斯的杰作，通过不可靠叙述者本托的回忆，讲述了一段因嫉妒而毁灭的爱情与友谊。小说以精妙的细节和大师级的模糊性，迫使读者在阅读中不断质疑、重读并自行判断。这部作品不仅是对人性猜忌的深刻剖析，更是对叙事艺术本身的反思——它教会我们如何以批判的眼光阅读，体会文学中真相与虚构的张力。值得每一位热爱文学与心理悬疑的读者细细品味。
items.summary_en: Dom Casmurro, a masterpiece by Brazilian literary giant Machado de Assis, is narrated by the unreliable Bentinho, whose memoir recounts a love and friendship destroyed by jealousy. With precise detail and masterly obfuscation, the novel forces readers to question, reread, and judge for themselves. More than a profound analysis of human suspicion, it is a reflection on the art of narrative itself—teaching us to read critically and appreciate the tension between truth and fiction in literature. A must-read for anyone who loves literary and psychological suspense.

items.title_cn: 书评：《已故的美洲人》，布兰登·泰勒著
items.title_en: Book Review: ‘The Late Americans,’ by Brandon Taylor
items.summary_cn: 布兰登·泰勒的新作《已故的美洲人》以爱荷华城为背景，描绘了一群居民——有人享有特权，有人没有——但他们都意识到自己的可能性正在收缩。小说深刻洞察了当代美国青年在阶级、欲望与艺术追求中的挣扎，笔触细腻而锋利。值得一读，因为它以精准的心理刻画和社交观察，揭示了后疫情时代下个体面对未来的普遍焦虑与无力感。
items.summary_en: Brandon Taylor’s novel, *The Late Americans*, is set in Iowa City and follows a group of residents—some privileged, some not—all aware that their possibilities are contracting. With sharp psychological insight and social observation, the book explores contemporary American youth’s struggles with class, desire, and artistic ambition. It is worth reading for its nuanced portrayal of individual anxiety and powerlessness in the face of the future, especially in the post-pandemic era.

items.title_cn: 马丁·艾米斯最佳书籍指南
items.title_en: Martin Amis’s Best Books: A Guide
items.summary_cn: 马丁·艾米斯共出版15部小说，以其机智与语言创造力广受赞誉。本指南梳理其最佳作品，为读者提供进入艾米斯文学世界的权威路径。无论你是初次接触还是重温经典，这份指南都能帮助你理解艾米斯为何被视为当代英语文学的重要声音，以及他如何以独特风格捕捉时代精神。值得看的原因在于：它既是对一位复杂作家的精要导览，也是理解20世纪末至21世纪初英语小说演变的一把钥匙。
items.summary_en: Martin Amis published 15 novels, acclaimed for their wit and linguistic inventiveness. This guide surveys his best books, offering an authoritative path into Amis's literary world. Whether you are a first-time reader or revisiting his work, it helps you understand why Amis is regarded as a major voice in contemporary English literature and how his distinctive style captures the spirit of his times. It is worth reading because it provides both a concise introduction to a complex writer and a key to understanding the evolution of the English novel from the late 20th to the early 21st century.

items.title_cn: 2024年最佳爱情小说（迄今）
